title: Chapter 6 — The Rumour
description: Somebody is saying you beat a student in 2016. Somebody else is printing it. Seyi wants to start a rumour back.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Tuesday morning. Every WhatsApp group in the ward has the same message: "TEACHER FLOGGED A JSS 1 GIRL UNCONSCIOUS IN 2016. ASK HIM." There is a blurry photo of a girl who is not from your school.

beats.speaker: funke
beats.text: Mrs. Adeyemi has forwarded it to me four times. With prayer emojis.

beats.speaker: seyi
beats.text: Owó Ńlá's boys. Classic. We hit back. I know a girl who will say his nephew got her pregnant. Truth is optional, Teacher. Speed is not.

beats.speaker: seyi
beats.text: He has the phone in his hand.

options.text: "No. We answer with the truth: my record, my students, my principal."
"Ignore it. Rumours die if you don't feed them."

beats.speaker: principal
beats.text: (on a voice note, which goes viral) I am Mrs. Bánkọ́lé. Mr. {name} taught at my school for eleven years. He resigned to run. In eleven years, he never raised his hand at a child. He raised their hands. To answer questions.

beats.speaker: principal
beats.text: (on a voice note, which goes viral) I am Mrs. Bánkọ́lé, his principal. He is on leave to run. In eleven years he never raised his hand at a child. He raised their hands. To answer questions.

beats.speaker: tolu
beats.text: (at dinner, scrolling) Daddy, my class is making TikToks of your old students thanking you. One of them is crying. (She shows you.) This is so embarrassing. I'm so proud.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Midnight. Someone is pasting the rumour as posters, right on top of yours, along the Front Stop.

won.toast: You catch him by the bucket of paste. He is sixteen. He was paid ₦1,500. He has a receipt. Owó Ńlá's campaign gives receipts.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: The boy is shaking. His hands are white with paste.

options.text: Pay him ₦3,000 to paste your posters instead, honestly.
Take the receipt to Wahala FM.
Let him go. He's a child.

beats.title: The Rumour
beats.summary: A lie went round the ward in a morning. The truth took a week, with its shoes on. You chose what to chase it with.
